title: Xenia and Tree
statementMd:
Xenia the programmer has a tree consisting of $*n*$ nodes. We will consider the tree nodes indexed from 1 to $*n*$. We will also consider the first node to be initially painted red, and the other nodes — to be painted blue.

The *distance* between two tree nodes $*v*$ and $*u*$ is the number of edges in the shortest path between $*v*$ and $*u*$.

Xenia needs to learn how to quickly execute queries of two types:

1. paint a specified blue node in red;
2. calculate which red node is the closest to the given one and print the shortest distance to the closest red node.

Your task is to write a program which will execute the described queries.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of nodes in the tree and the number of queries. Next $*n* - 1$ lines contain the tree edges, the $*i*$-th line contains a pair of integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*})$ — an edge of the tree.

Next $*m*$ lines contain queries. Each query is specified as a pair of integers $*t*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$. If $*t*_{*i*} = 1$, then as a reply to the query we need to paint a blue node $*v*_{*i*}$ in red. If $*t*_{*i*} = 2$, then we should reply to the query by printing the shortest distance from some red node to node $*v*_{*i*}$.

It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree and that all queries are correct.

## Output

For each second type query print the reply in a single line.
statementZhMd:
Xenia 是一名程序员，她有一棵由 $*n*$ 个节点组成的树。我们将树上的节点编号为 1 到 $*n*$。初始时，第一个节点被染成红色，其余节点被染成蓝色。

树上两个节点 $*v*$ 和 $*u*$ 之间的*距离*，是它们之间最短路径上的边数。

Xenia 需要快速执行以下两种查询：

1. 将指定的蓝色节点染成红色；
2. 找出距离给定节点最近的红色节点，并输出到该最近红色节点的最短距离。

你的任务是编写一个程序，执行上述查询。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$，分别表示树中节点的数量和查询的数量。接下来 $*n*$ - 1 行描述树的边，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*})$，表示树中的一条边。

接下来 $*m*$ 行包含查询。每个查询由两个整数 $*t*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ 表示。如果 $*t*_{*i*}$ = 1，则需要将蓝色节点 $*v*_{*i*}$ 染成红色。如果 $*t*_{*i*}$ = 2，则需要输出从某个红色节点到节点 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的最短距离。

保证给定的图是一棵树，并且所有查询都是合法的。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二类查询，在单独一行中输出答案。
